'''Sel Maa''' was a [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] socialite [[Coruscanti/Legends|from]] the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. During the last [[Standard decade/Legends|decades]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], she [[Gambling/Legends|gambled]] and spent [[Time/Legends|time]] with the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Daro Willits]] at the [[Outlander Club/Legends|Outlander Club]] on her [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]]. In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], she visited the club and flirted with Willits when the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Zam Wesell/Legends|Zam Wesell]] ran into the club to [[Plot to assassinate Senator Amidala/Legends|hide]] from the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]].

==Biography==
Sel Maa was a [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]]<ref name="CSWE" /> [[Gender/Legends|female]]<ref name="sm" /> socialite<ref name="IA">{{SWArchive|url=episode-ii/explore/attack/2003/05/imageattack20030512.html|series=Image Attack|text=Flirting in the Shadows}}</ref> [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] [[Coruscanti/Legends|to]]<ref name="sm" /> the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="CL">[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2005)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']]</ref> [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. She was a [[Gambling/Legends|gambling]] club patron during the last [[Standard decade/Legends|decades]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] at the [[Outlander Club/Legends|Outlander Club]],<ref name="sm" /> a [[Nightclub/Legends|nightclub]] and gambling hall in the [[Uscru Entertainment District/Legends|Uscru Entertainment District]] of Coruscant.<ref name="CSWE2">{{CSWECite|II|431|Outlander Club}}</ref> Maa spent a great deal of [[Time/Legends|time]] with<ref name="sm" /> the [[Human/Legends|Human]]<ref name="Insider" /> [[Daro Willits]] when at the club.<ref name="sm" />

During a [[Standard day/Legends|night]]<ref name="aotc">{{Film|II}}</ref> in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of {{Film|II}} to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].</ref> she visited the club, drinking next to the bar and talking with two [[Rodian/Legends|Rodians]] and a [[Pacithhip/Legends|Pacithhip]] just before two [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], entered searching for the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Zam Wesell/Legends|Zam Wesell]] after her [[Plot to assassinate Senator Amidala/Legends|assassination attempt]] on [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]].<ref name="aotc" /> As the two walked in, she moved to a private alcove of the club<ref name="IA" /> near the entrance<ref name="aotc" /> and held a willing audience with Willits,<ref name="Insider" /> flirting with him<ref name="Insider" /> and conversing with fellow patron [[Reha Logg]].<ref name="Depth">{{HomeVideoCite|film=2|featurette=Depth Commentary}}</ref> Just moments after, she returned to the bar and stood with the [[Alien/Legends|aliens]]. Maa then went back to talking with Logg and Willits as Skywalker searched the club for Wesell.<ref name="aotc" /> 

==Personality and traits==
Maa had [[Color/Legends|blonde]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]] styled in a [[Bee/Legends|beehive]] hairdo<ref name="Insider" /> and brown [[Eye/Legends|eyes]]. Her skin color comprised of red, orange, yellow, green, blue, and purple, but was light-colored around her face.<ref name="CSWE" /> She had a sympathetic [[Ear/Legends|ear]] for Daro Willits,<ref name="Insider" /> flirting with him on the night she visited<ref name="IA" /> in 22 [['ABY-BBY' dating system/Legends|BBY]].<ref name="NEC" />

==Equipment==
While at the nightclub, Maa wore silver-colored [[Clothing/Legends|heels]] and a sequined bodysuit. She also had sequins on her face, hair, and body.<ref name="IA" /> 

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|With high heels, a beehive hairdo and a mod bodysuit, Sel Maa is retro-futurism at its finest &ndash; the type of woman who should have been serving cocktails aboard a rocket jet in a 1960s sci-fi fantasy.|Daniel Wallace|<ref name="Insider" />}}
[[File:SelMaa-CompleteSaga.png|thumb|right|350px|Sel Maa was portrayed by an uncredited extra (right).]]
Sel Maa first appeared in the [[prequel trilogy]] film [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']],<ref name="aotc" /> which was released on [[May 16]], [[2002]].<ref name="Year">''[[Star Wars Year By Year: A Visual History, New Edition]]''</ref> The Outlander Club scenes including Maa, who was portrayed by an uncredited extra,<ref name="aotc" /> were shot at [[Fox Studios, Sydney]] on [[July 17]], [[2000]].<ref name="Mythmaking">''[[Mythmaking: Behind the Scenes of Attack of the Clones]]''</ref> Maa's rainbow body makeup was done by Makeup Supervisor [[Lesley Vanderwalt]] and her team of eight makeup artists.<ref name="Lesley Vanderwalt2">{{SWArchive|url=episode-ii/feature/20020215/index.html|text=Making Up is Hard to Do: Lesley Vanderwalt}}</ref>

Maa and other patrons of the Outlander Club were named by George Lucas and his film production company, [[Lucasfilm]], during the summer of 2000 in anticipation for spin-off fiction opportunities and licensing.<ref name="crc">{{SWArchive|url=episode-iv/bts/article/f20030502/index.html|text=Cantina Roll-Call: Shedding Light on Some Alien Aliases|int=Cantina Roll-Call: Shedding Light on Some Alien Aliases}}</ref> The character was first revealed when the extra playing Sel Maa, in costume, introduced the twelfth episode of the Episode II behind-the-scenes video series [[On location|''on location'']].<ref name="On location">{{SWArchive|url=episode-ii/bts/onloc/12.html|series=On Location|text=Part 12 - Jedi Beverage Break}}</ref> The episode, "Jedi Beverage Break," was released on [[October 17]], 2000.<ref name="Archive">{{SWArchive|url=episode-ii/bts/onloc/archive.html|text=''on location'' archive}}</ref>

The character was first identified in an Episode II [[Depth Commentary]] available on [[StarWars.com]] that could be accessed through the DVD-ROM home release of ''Attack of the Clones''<ref name="Depth" /> on [[November 12]], 2002.<ref name="DVD">{{SWArchive|url=episode-ii/news/2002/08/news20020801.html|text=Episode II On DVD & VHS}}</ref> In the [[April 6]], [[2004]],<ref name="SW.com">{{SWArchive|url=community/fanclub/mag/news20040315.html|text=The New Face of Evil}}</ref> article "[[Who's Who in the Outlander Club: It's Ladies' Night]]," published in the [[Star Wars Insider 75|seventy-fifth issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars Insider]]'' magazine, author [[Daniel Wallace]] described Maa as the finest of retro-futurism. Wallace also wrote that she is the type of woman who would have been serving cocktails aboard a rocket jet in a science fiction fantasy from the [[1960s]].<ref name="Insider" />
